title: Accept ADR 0068 (as amended by the review): the stream table
body: A new read-only operation `get_stream_table(job)` on every surface (Python, CLI `openflowsheet streams` as text, JSON or CSV, HTTP, MCP). It is computed when asked from the run's replay bundle: nothing is stored, no released number or replay changes, and 0.3.0 runs get a table too. Values a provider cannot give are shown as absent with a reason, never estimated.

Amended by the review (rule R1′): a stream whose phase split a flash cannot determine (a temperature-degenerate split) takes the split the solver carries, as the certificate check does, or reports the value as absent. This fixed a 2016 W error on one test case.
